changelog:
## v1.9.27

- Fix: Standardized ZIP archive directory paths to POSIX forward-slashes (/), preventing cPanel/Linux extraction failure and rollback folder generation
- Hardened upgrader_post_install hooks against WP_Error and unexpected non-array returns
- Added self-healing cleanup for legacy sub-plugin folders and database entries
- 3 Modular Elementor Widgets: Product Grid with Tiered Discounts, Variation Selector, Embedded Checkout
- Order Tagging System and HPOS Admin Badges
